invariants: Known application instants persist as canonical UTC whole seconds; date-only values, durations, unknown effective times and unresolved source chronology remain distinct non-instants.

America/Guayaquil governs ordinary operational and SLA calendar interpretation; Objective/Task selectable IANA timezone is confined to scheduling input/presentation and does not reinterpret other-domain chronology.
Timezone display changes never mutate existing canonical instants; wall-clock-preserving changes require a reviewed reschedule.
Import/discovery/indexing/current time never substitutes for missing external business chronology unless an explicit owning requirement defines that time as the fact itself.
Lifecycle occurrence/effective chronology and audit recording chronology are independently represented when both exist.
Lifecycle evidence, application audit, proposal/job history and technical diagnostics are never collapsed into one authority.
Every required authoritative mutation, lifecycle event and audit record succeeds atomically or rolls back together.
Accepted audit rows are append-only and immutable at the application/persistence boundary; duplicate audit identity is an explicit integrity failure.
Command idempotency is resolved before audit insertion; replay does not create duplicate accepted audit/lifecycle events.
Corrections preserve and reference original accepted evidence and append new evidence rather than overwriting history.
Hard deletion exists only where an owning-domain rule explicitly authorizes it after dependency validation; history preservation is the default.
Derived projections, caches, summaries and materialized read models are rebuildable and never authorize write-side truth.
Projection recomputation alone creates no lifecycle occurrence or acceptance audit event.
Stale revision/precondition mismatch blocks commit and returns conflict/review state; last-write-wins is prohibited for identity, evidence and lifecycle truth.
Cross-domain atomic workflows preserve each domain's validation/ownership and never implement orchestration through direct foreign-table mutation.
Historical snapshots/reports preserve the effective timezone/offset/as-of/policy context required to reproduce their accepted result.
acceptance_hooks: idempotent replay creates no duplicate accepted evidence
projection rebuild emits no lifecycle event
exceptional deletion preserves required minimized audit and independent survivors
